title: HARVESTING PROCESS ENGINEERING
description: Timber harvesting equipment and systems. Harvesting process evaluation and decisions aided by forest engineering analysis.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: (ENGR 211 or 211H) and FE 102.
A minimum grade of C is required in ENGR 211, ENGR 211H and FE 102.

INTO OSU GE/AE/Pathways or Non-Degree / Credential level students may not enroll.
